pkgmetadata.longdescription: The Google Cloud CLI (formerly Google Cloud SDK) is a set of tools to create and manage Google Cloud resources: gcloud, gsutil and bq. This package installs the upstream release tarball, runs it on the system Python instead of the bundled interpreter, and disables the built-in component manager. Extra components (kubectl, emulators, App Engine runtimes, ...) are not available through "gcloud components"; install them from the tree instead.
